Everyone likes to have control over their own choices, especially regarding their diet. If my SO finds out and feels upset, it could create tension. It's important to maintain open communication and ensure that both of us feel respected and valued in our decisions. I should also think about alternative approaches. Maybe instead of switching the yogurt secretly, I could have a conversation with my SO about the issues I'm noticing.
